title: S11T07 - Update agent workflows and handoff wording for git health caveats
description: Make workflow playbooks and agent-facing guidance precise about git health caveats so closeouts stop normalizing vague unhealthy sync reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Relevant health, router, work-planning, sprint-launch, and closeout workflows describe when git findings are blockers, warnings, or expected collaboration caveats.
Closeout wording uses exact categories instead of saying sync is unhealthy when only expected git policy findings remain.
Skills point agents to repair or branch guidance only when the structured diagnostic says it is needed.
closedReason: Workflow wording accepted: closeout and routing guidance no longer normalizes vague unhealthy sync reports for non-blocking Git findings.
